message.content:
Looking at the strip, the entire sequence is rendered in grayscale, which immediately tells me the source film was shot in black‑and‑white. That narrows the list to a handful of B&W horror titles (Carnival of Souls, House on Haunted Hill, Night of the Living Dead, The Last Man on Earth).

The temporal pattern is mostly a steady mid‑gray with two pronounced dark dips (roughly a third and four‑fifths of the way through) and brief bright flashes at the very start and end. This profile — daytime/bright opening, a dark middle stretch, and a dark climactic finale — matches the well‑known black‑and‑white footage of *Night of the Living Dead* far better than the very pale, washed‑out look of *Carnival of Souls* or the consistently candle‑lit interiors of *House on Haunted Hill*.

Answer: I
